description: Paralock HTLC (htlc mode): redeem script template, P2SH encoding, and the funding, claim and refund transactions exactly as @paralock/zcash builds them. Signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic, so every signed transaction is reproducible byte for byte. transactions.errors are built with the fixture options (branch id BRANCH_ID_NU6_3, network testnet, conventional fee); transactions.validationErrors may override them with `fee` (zatoshi) or `branchId` and must be refused too, but only the refusal is normative there.

funding.description: 3 UTXOs (3 logical actions: 15,000 zat) → HTLC + change
change of 999 zat is below the dust limit: dropped into the fee (fee 10,999)
change of exactly 1,000 zat (the dust limit) is kept
same as the first funding but signed for NU5 (branch id 0xc2d6d0b4): sighash and txid change

claim.description: maker claims the funded HTLC with the secret (lock_time 0, sequence final, expiry 0)
claim of an 11,000 zat HTLC: the output is exactly the 1,000 zat dust limit

refund.description: taker refunds the HTLC (lock_time = refund height, sequence 0xfffffffe, expiry 0)
